Exclusive resource coalitions include exited helpers and coalition-owned Metal compiler and CascadeSets update services; GPU execution and services outside the coalition are excluded. Full story/comment-row identity is checked after the measured PNG endpoint. The asymmetric window setup makes this interval diagnostic only. This is a capture workflow comparison, not identical internal rendering endpoints.
